newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

In answer to a question, spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said the Commission would consider third countries' offers to open their market to European textile products during its weekly meeting on Wednesday. Van der Pas said the Commission's proposal would go beyond the ones received by a number of third countries so far.

Van der Pas also said that there was no fixed agenda for this afternoon's inter-governmental conference (IGC) ministerial meeting in Luxembourg and that the formal negotiation phase of the IGC would not take place before December.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/868: Ritt Bjerregaard: "We need the French national list under the Natura 2000 now!".
- IP/96/869: Commission calls for urgent action by Argentina to avert dispute in textiles trade.
- IP/96/871: Commission clears the creation of a joint venture between Temic and Leica in adaptive cruise control systems.
- IP/96/872: European Union policies and health.
- Speech/96/231: Speech by Commissioner Edith Cresson at the Condorcet meetings.
- Speech/96/: Address by Commissioner Franz Fischler on the common agricultural policy, future developments and questions on enlargement.
- ECHO news No 12: When a cyclone hits a cardboard city...
- European Commission, Regional success stories, profiles of 36 projects in Europe.
- Main points at the agenda of Commission's meeting on 2 October 1996.
